title: Route 22 & Viridian Forest
subtitle: Optional rival battle, the forest maze, arrive at Pewter City

steps.text: Route 22 (west of Viridian): catch a Nidoran♂/♀ and Mankey. Nidoking/Nidoqueen carry the whole game and Mankey beats Brock.
Rival battle 2 on Route 22 (walk toward the League gate). He has a Lv.9 Pidgey and his starter at Lv.9; be Lv.10+ or bring a second Pokémon.
Route 2: go north into Viridian Forest. Catch a Pikachu if you are patient (5%). Caterpie becomes Butterfree by Lv.10 and its Confusion (special) is a real answer to Brock.
Viridian Forest: follow the winding path north; the Bug Catchers each give a small fight. Poison from Weedle is common: keep Antidotes.
Pewter City: heal, buy Potions. The Museum (₽50) has fossils on display; the Old Amber is behind the back door and needs Cut later.

Before Brock: Rock is weak to Water, Grass, Fighting, Ground. Mankey's Low Kick, Squirtle's Bubble, Bulbasaur's Vine Whip, Butterfree's Confusion all work. Charmander users: grind to Lv.13 for Metal Claw or use Mankey.
